Overview.Name: Soundarya Kollimarla
Overview.Goal: Reduce body fat, improve hormonal balance, feel energetic and confident, and achieve visible physique changes with simple, sustainable meals.

Meal_1_Breakfast: OR Curd bowl + vegetable stir fry
Meal_2_Lunch: Paneer curry + 1 cup rice + cooked vegetables
OR Curd rice (small portion) + vegetable side
OR Paneer pan fried + vegetables + small rice

Notes_and_Tips: Focus on paneer and curd daily to support fat loss and hormonal balance.
Keep meals low in sugar and refined foods to support thyroid and PCOS health.
Since stress and late nights trigger cravings, keep dinner light and protein-focused.
Avoid sweets and fried foods on work shift days; replace with curd or makhana.
Try to finish dinner at least 2 hours before sleep for better digestion.
Repeat meals on busy days to avoid decision fatigue and overeating.
Increase daily movement slowly toward 6,000–7,000 steps for better fat loss.
Stay consistent rather than perfect; visible body changes will follow routine.
